payload.description: Simulator-generated dataset for ML contingency screening: one row per (network, operating point, outaged branch). Labels come from pandapower AC N-1 power flows, NOT from historical outages.

sampling.dispatch: pandapower AC OPF (PIPS, flat start): PGLib costs x cost noise, PMIN/PMAX, VMIN/VMAX, branch |S| <= RATE_A (OPF_FLOW_LIM=0); generator Q limits relaxed to +/-100000 Mvar; ANGMIN/ANGMAX ignored.
sampling.acceptance: AC OPF converged, base AC power flow converged and base N-0 secure (no thermal or voltage violation); rejections counted per network.

label_definition.primary: Absolute post-outage thermal >100 % OR energised-bus voltage outside case limits OR AC numerical non-convergence; tolerances 0.01 percentage points and 0.0001 pu.
label_definition.secondary_aggravated: Non-convergence OR new violation OR worsening of an existing thermal violation by 5 percentage points or voltage excess by 0.01 pu; this is NOT the primary absolute label. On the N-0 secure bases used here it coincides with the primary.
label_definition.islanding: Separate diagnostic; converged islands with unsupplied load are not counted as numerical non-convergence. Disconnected MW retained per row.
label_definition.power_flow: NR max_iteration=30, numba=True, enforce_q_lims=False; warm-start from base AC then DC and flat retries. Only LoadflowNotConverged is caught.
